title: The 'NON-GMO Project Verified' Label is WRONG
summary: Farm channel argues the Non-GMO Project label misleads by flagging foods with no engineered version and implying engineered food is unsafe.

assertions.quote: a lot of the things that happen on GMO product verified label don't even have any genetically engineered varieties
G crops are tested more than any crop in history and are proved to be just as safe and nutritious as non GE varieties

verdicts.note: The 2016 National Academies review found no evidence that approved engineered crops are less safe to eat.
